html.p: Network Diagram Viz is not installed. The CDP topology diagram below needs it. Install "Network Diagram Viz" from Splunkbase (see splunk/README.md), then reload this page.

panel.title: CDP topology. Switches, APs (wifi icon) and firewalls (brick wall) by health: green OK, yellow warning, red critical, dark grey no data. Click a switch for Switch Details, an AP for Wireless Overview, a firewall for Firewall Details

search.query: | `mdt_cdp(*)` | where NOT match(interface, "(?i)^(mgmt|e0m)") AND NOT match(coalesce(remote_interface, ""), "(?i)^(mgmt|e0m)") | eval from=node, to=neighbour, nk=lower(neighbour) | join type=left nk [| mstats count(_value) WHERE `mdt_metrics_index` metric_name=mdt_panos_* BY extracted_source | eval nk=lower(extracted_source), fw=extracted_source | fields nk fw] | eval to=coalesce(fw, to) | append [| mstats latest(_value) WHERE `mdt_metrics_index` metric_name=mdt_wl_info_ap_name BY ap_name cdp_cache_data_cdp_cache_device_id | eval from=ap_name, to=replace(cdp_cache_data_cdp_cache_device_id, "\..*$", ""), interface="uplink" | fields from to interface] | where from!=to | eval node1=if(from<to, from, to), node2=if(from<to, to, from) | stats count by node1 node2 | eval from=node1, to=node2, linkwidth=2 | appendpipe [| eval node=mvappend(from, to) | stats count by node | eval color="#7b8794" | rename node as from | fields from color] | append [| `mdt_switch_health` | eval color=case(health=="Critical", "#dc4e41", health=="Warning", "#f8be34", health=="OK", "#53a051", true(), "#3c444d") | rename node as from | fields from color] | append [| `mdt_ap_health` | eval color=case(health=="Critical", "#dc4e41", health=="Warning", "#f8be34", health=="OK", "#53a051", true(), "#3c444d"), type="wifi" | rename ap as from | fields from color type] | append [| `mdt_firewall_health` | eval color=case(health=="Critical", "#dc4e41", health=="Warning", "#f8be34", health=="OK", "#53a051", true(), "#3c444d"), type="customimage", customurl="/static/app/mdt_infra_monitoring/icons/firewall-".case(health=="Critical", "critical", health=="Warning", "warning", health=="OK", "ok", true(), "nodata").".svg", from=node | fields from color type customurl] | appendpipe [| `mdt_topology_positions`] | eventstats max(x) as x max(y) as y max(value) as value by from | eventstats values(eval(if(isnull(x), from, null()))) as hidden | where isnotnull(x) AND (isnull(hidden) OR isnull(to) OR isnull(mvfind(hidden, "^\Q".to."\E$"))) | table from to linkwidth color type customurl x y value

panel.title: Switch health, last 15 minutes. Warning from 70 % (CPU, memory, busiest port) or above 5 errors/min, critical from 90 % or 100 errors/min. Click for Switch Details

search.query: | `mdt_switch_health` | eval order=case(health=="Critical", 0, health=="Warning", 1, health=="No data", 2, true(), 3) | sort order node | rename node as Switch, health as Health, cpu as "CPU %", mem as "Memory %", util as "Busiest port %", errors as "Errors/min (busiest port)" | table Switch Health "CPU %" "Memory %" "Busiest port %" "Errors/min (busiest port)"

panel.title: Wireless clients, last 15 minutes, all WLCs. Click for Wireless Overview

search.query: | mstats latest(mdt_wl_ap_stats_num_assoc_clients) as c WHERE `mdt_metrics_index` span=1m BY extracted_source ssid_counters_wtp_mac ssid_counters_slot_id ssid_counters_wlan_id | where _time + 60 <= now() | stats sum(c) as c by _time | stats latest(c) as clients
| `mdt_ap_health` | stats count as total count(eval(state=="joined")) as joined | eval aps=joined." / ".total | fields aps

panel.title: WLC CPU %, highest WLC. Warning from 70, critical from 90

search.query: | mstats latest(mdt_xe_cpu_stats_one_minute) as cpu WHERE `mdt_metrics_index` [| mcatalog values(extracted_source) as extracted_source WHERE `mdt_metrics_index` metric_name=mdt_wl_info_ap_ip_addr | mvexpand extracted_source] BY extracted_source | stats max(cpu) as cpu | eval cpu=round(cpu, 0)

panel.title: WLC memory %, highest WLC. Warning from 70, critical from 90

search.query: | mstats latest(mdt_xe_mem_stats_used_memory) as used latest(mdt_xe_mem_stats_total_memory) as total WHERE `mdt_metrics_index` [| mcatalog values(extracted_source) as extracted_source WHERE `mdt_metrics_index` metric_name=mdt_wl_info_ap_ip_addr | mvexpand extracted_source] BY extracted_source memory_statistic_name | stats sum(used) as used sum(total) as total by extracted_source | eval mem=used / total * 100 | stats max(mem) as mem | eval mem=round(mem, 1)

panel.title: AP health, last 15 minutes. Channel busy % (rx + tx + noise, worst radio) warns from 50 and is critical from 75; interference warns from 25 and is critical from 50; an AP not joined or an enabled radio down is critical. Click for Wireless Overview

search.query: | `mdt_ap_health` | eval order=case(health=="Critical", 0, health=="Warning", 1, health=="No data", 2, true(), 3) | sort order ap | eval busy=if(isnotnull(busy), busy." % (".busy_band.")", null()) | rename wlc as WLC, ap as AP, health as Health, state as State, clients as Clients, busy as "Channel busy (worst radio)", inter as "Interference % (worst radio)", radios_down as "Radios down" | table AP Health State Clients "Channel busy (worst radio)" "Interference % (worst radio)" "Radios down" WLC

ul.li: Patterns are host names. * matches any text. A device takes the role of the longest pattern that matches it. Adding an existing pattern changes its role.
Roles: core, distribution and access are the rows of the tree, top to bottom. APs (wifi) are always the bottom row and need no entry.
Firewalls sit above the cores, over their neighbours. wlc and server sit on the distribution row, right of the distribution switches.
hidden: the device and its links are left out of the topology (for example servers).
Devices without a role are placed one row below their highest neighbour by CDP link. Devices not reached from a role device go to the islands block on the far right.
Changes show on the Overview tab after its next refresh (1 minute). Only admin and power users can save.
